patch.value: Reconcile git main to the 2026.8.9 release npm already serves

On 2026-08-09 the daily release published pm-linear@2026.8.9 to npm, but the protected-branch push was rejected (GH006) so git main is still at 2026.8.7 with no v2026.08.09 tag. Bring package.json/package-lock.json, manifest.json, the index.ts version literal, and CHANGELOG.md up to 2026.8.9 so git matches the immutable npm release. Do not create or push the git tag; the orchestrator tags it after the PR merges.
